panels.title: DB table reads (records/s)
panels.description: Diagnostic range activity: ten fixed named tables per metric/run, plus the complementary display Other. Totals include observed startup/drain activity and require coverage throughout selected workload phases; unobserved provisioning/cleanup is excluded. Full table detail is available in Database Activity.

panels.title: DB table reads (total)
panels.description: Diagnostic range activity: ten fixed named tables per metric/run, plus the complementary display Other. The additional Total sums every table and Other exactly once per run; unavailable contributions make the Total unavailable. Totals include observed startup/drain activity and require coverage throughout selected workload phases; unobserved provisioning/cleanup is excluded. Full table detail is available in Database Activity.

panels.title: PAS ABL processing time
panels.description:
Average ABL processing time across all PAS instances, weighted by each instance's request rate; one line per run.

p95 unavailable: the PAS metric has no distribution

targets.expr: sum by (run_id) (parkbench_openedge_pas_avg_abl_processing_seconds{run_id=~"$run_id"} * on (run_id, replica) group_left () sum by (run_id, replica) (rate(parkbench_openedge_pas_requests_total{run_id=~"$run_id"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (run_id) (sum by (run_id, replica) (rate(parkbench_openedge_pas_requests_total{run_id=~"$run_id"}[$__rate_interval])))
